Title: General Availability: ASP. NET web app migration to Azure App Service using PowerShell Scripts

Body.Content:
General availability of ASP. Net web app Migration to Azure App Service using PowerShell Scripts is now available.  

PowerShell scripts for migration ASP .NET web apps to Azure App Service provides following key capabilities: 

  • Support for ASP.NET web apps hosted on IIS 7.5+ web servers with no product installation needed, just copy the scripts. 
  • These PowerShell scripts can be used to discover, assess and migrate ASP. Net web apps to App service from a variety of virtualized or physical infrastructure platforms ex:  VMWare & Hyper-V environments, web roles (Azure Cloud Services Extended Support), Azure VM's (Windows OS), Physical servers
  • Perform bulk migration of ASP.NET web apps from a single IIS web server to Azure App service.
  • Option to package sites and move them to an alternate server for a subsequent deployment step. This mechanism enables support for part offline & online migration scenarios. 

For details about the PowerShell migration scripts please refer to ASP. Net web app Migration to Azure App Service using PowerShell Scripts - Microsoft Community Hub or visit Azure App Service migration tools | Microsoft Azure.
